name: buginbox
description: BugInbox - website feedback and bug reporting for solo developers

scripts.build: npm run build -w @buginbox/shared && npm run build -w @buginbox/widget && npm run build -w @buginbox/server && npm run build -w @buginbox/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @buginbox/shared && npm run typecheck -w @buginbox/widget && npm run typecheck -w @buginbox/server && npm run typecheck -w @buginbox/dashboard
